Description: This is a Unique Item. This exquisitely crafted lute was created by Charimytha, the former Goddess of Love, during the height of her grace and benevolence. Charimytha poured her love and passion into each curve of its elegant frame. The strings are woven from the threads of Charimytha’s own platinum-white hair, shimmering faintly with her divine power. A lingering echo of the deity’s once-pure essence. After her slow corruption and tragic demise from the Dark Hero, the Strings remained untouched for eons. Some say that through the lute, the goddess’s spirit still seeks redemption—or perhaps revenge.

Effect: Permanently doubles Charisma. All Charisma bonuses from gear are now permanently applied to the holder even when gear is removed. Increase 2 stats by + 200. Increases all buffs and benefits from Bard Spells by 60%. Grants level 10 Love Vampire skill. Grants level 10 Alluring Voice skill. 

)

Spells

**Level 15 Entourage spell**
**Target:** Self and Party
**Duration:** Until disrupted
**Cool down:** 20 mins
**Mana:** 20 per party member

**Description:** Summon a dazzling display of illusionary duplicates of the party. The illusions cannot deal damage. At level 5, Illusions can be coordinated to move individually. At level 10, the caster can throw their own voice into the illusions. At Level 15, Illusions are granted a resistance to detection via True Sight unless the caster is taken out.

**Level 17 Bard Spell: All Eyes on Me**
**Target:** Line of sight and close enough to hear
**Mana Cost:** 0 (Optional mana use increases duration)
**Duration:** Half the caster's Charisma (rounded down) in minutes + 1 minute per mana point optionally used.
**Cooldown:** 30 minutes

**Description:** The caster sings a song in tune to affect everyone in line of sight. The better the caster sings, the more effective it will be. This spell doesn't inherently cost mana to cast, however, the caster can optionally spend mana to extend the spell's duration by 1 minute per point. This particular spell focuses the attention on a subject of the caster's choice. It can be a mob, an adventurer, or even a non-living object. At level 15, this spell's effectiveness increases against larger mobs and even Bosses of their Charisma is high enough.

Note: Deafened creatures are immune to this spell's effects.


**Level 15 Bard Spell: Standing Ovation**
**Target:** Party
**Mana cost:** 0 (Optional mana use increases radius by 1 foot per mana point)
**Duration:** Once per fight
**Cooldown:** 20 minutes

**Description:** Increases all party members' Dexterity by 35% and amplifies their spell effectiveness, boosting damage and healing output of their abilities by 30%. Additionally, the sheer confidence radiating from the bard's performance grants the party a temporary immunity to fear-based spells. This spell does not require mana to cast, but for every additional mana point spent, the area of effect increases by 1 foot. 

Note: Deafened creatures are immune to this spell's effects.

**Level 15 Bard Spell: Encore**
**Target:** Party
**Mana Cost:** 0 (Optional mana use increases radius by 1 foot per mana point)
**Cool down:** 10 minutes

**Description:** Unleashes a surge of magical harmony that invigorates the party, healing all allies within the radius by 60% of their maximum health and cleansing up to five harmful debuffs per target. This spell doesn't require mana to cast, but for every additional mana point spent,  the area of effect increases by 1 foot. 

Note: Deafened creatures are immune to this spell's effects.

**Level 15 Bard Spell: Vicious Mockery**
**Target/radius:** 60 ft + 1 inch × half Caster's Charisma (800)
**Duration:** Instantaneous
**Cool down:** 1 hour
Description: The Caster unleashes a string of magical insults at a target within range. This spell's damage increases by 10% per level. The amount of damage dealt is equal to target's charisma. This spell has a 20% chance to inflict the Intrusive Thoughts debuff.

Note: Deafened creatures are immune to this spell's effects.

**Level 10 Bard Spell: Searing Vocals**
**Target/radius:** 80 feet
**Mana Cost:** 0
**Duration:** Instantaneous
**Cool down:** 1 hour

**Description:** Unleashing the full power of their voice, the bard unleashes an ear-shattering, heavy metal scream imbued with fire magic, sending waves of flaming sonic energy through the air. All mobs will take damage equal to the caster's Intelligence (700). Objects and structures in the radius also catch fire if they are flammable. Additionally, allies within the radius gain a temporary Metalhead Buff that boost Strength and Dexterity equal to the bard's base Charisma (300).

Note: Deafened creatures are immune to this spell's effects.

**Level 15 Mermaid Transformation Spell**
**Target:** Self
**Mana Cost:** 100
**Duration:** Instantaneous
**Cool down:** 4 hours

**Description:** The Caster turns into a Mermaid for as long as they want. This spell can be switched off at any time. Purifies water on touch. At Level 10, this spell will grant a 50% boost to all music-based spells.
)

**Level 10 Cockroach**

**Target:** Self

**Description:** Gives the user a chance to survive a fatal attack. At level 5, the user is guaranteed one free lethal hit a fight, though they'll be near death afterward. At level 10, the user's health doesn't go down at all after the first fatal strike.

At level 10, a total of four mobs can be targeted with this skill. At level 15, a total of 8 mobs can be targeted with this skill.

**Level 10 Walk on Water**
**Duration:** 20 minutes
**Cool down:** 3 hours

**Description:** Allows the user to walk on water without sinking. It is ill-advised to use this at the ocean.

**Level 7 Torch Song**
**Target:** Single 
**Cool down:** 10 minutes

**Description:** The user sings a powerful melody rife with raging flames, scorching the target. This skill also buffs the user's Constitution by 10% per cast. May have a chance to inflict the Lingering Burn Debuff on an opponent.

Level 11 Alluring Voice
**Target/radius:** 30 feet from user
**Cool down:** 15 minutes.

**Description:** The user attacks the target using their angelic voice. Any opponents caught within range will have their Intelligence decrease by 1/3rd. At level 10, it has a chance of inflicting the Stun Debuff if their opponents stats have been boosted.

Background: Samantha is the daughter of a legendary bard, which comes with the usual stereotypes people associate with that class—seducing dragons, stealing the hearts of Elf Queens, etc. She was born from her father’s second wife, a childhood friend turned lover. Samantha has lots of extended family she’s only met a handful of times throughout her life.

When Samantha was ten, a Witch came and put a curse on her. Why? Because this particular Witch happened to be one of her Father’s lovers and got sick and tired of him being a dirty, unfaithful bastard. To get back at him, she cursed Samantha with Crippling Nymphomania. The effects were slow, but when they started to hit during puberty, they hit like a goddamn avalanche. She fucked every single person in close proximity to her before she ended it by seduced the ever-loving fuck out of her own mother.

When Samantha finally managed to get a grip of herself, she was absolutely horrified at what she’d done and what she’d become. She hated herself, but even more, she started to hate her father. Samantha blamed him for the curse, for making her the target of a Witch’s twisted revenge. If it weren’t for him and his constant screwing around, none of this would’ve happened to her. She left her home, disgusted and ashamed, vowing to track down the Witch make her undo her curse. But if she wouldn’t fix what she did, Samantha decided she’d kill her. No hesitation. She didn’t care how dangerous it would be. Anything was better than staying like this.

Samantha became an adventurer, choosing to be a Bard like her Father not to honor him. Because of her crippling Nymphomania, she had to release her pent up sexual frustration every three days to keep it at bay. She used her Bard magic to seduce people, mainly single men and women, to calm the effects. She visited every town, battling the curse every day to stay in control. It hadn't been easy, and she’s left a lot of broken hearts (and beds) behind her. 

She eventually met the Legendary Hero, Fiona, and the first member of her party, the Amazon Megatrona. They were on a Quest to defeat the Demon King, and they could use a Bard of Samantha's talents. At first, Samantha was skeptical of them. Joining a party of heroes meant traveling with people who would inevitably find out about her curse, and she wasn’t eager to explain her history to anyone. But Fiona insisted, telling her that there maybe—just maybe—might be a way to rid her curse in the Demon King's Castle. 

Of course, Samantha joined them. For the next two years, they would meet a lot of people along the way. She even got pregnant along the way until they reached the Demon King's Castle. However, instead of fighting the Demon King directly like the rest of her party, Samantha seduced his wife, the Demon Queen, and his daughter. This left the Demon King despondent enough for Fiona to land the final blow. As such, she has been bestowed the title of “Demon Charmer” for pulling off what no Bard ever accomplished.

Samantha returned to her home village, having settled down at a house far from the village. After having seduced the Demon Queen, she gave the Bard an easy to make potion recipe that would help treat her Crippling Nymphomania. The ingredients needed come from the spawn of a Tentacle Beast, so Samantha keeps one in her basement.
